docs.title: About this book
docs.text:
An introduction to analogue and digital electronics: passive components, diodes and rectifiers, bipolar and field-effect transistors, amplifier design, operational amplifiers, oscillators, logic gates and counters, and practical circuit building.

From Wikibooks · CC BY-SA 4.0

Electronics, a Wikibooks textbook, by its contributors. This book is not stored in this library: each chapter is read from Wikibooks when it is opened, shown in this library's format, and ends with its own attribution. Licence: CC BY-SA 4.0. Modified: converted to this format.
